description: Ten questions that check real understanding of The Beatles. Answers included so you can self-test.
key_points: Q: What is The Beatles known for? A: Sgt. Pepper
Q: What field did The Beatles work in? A: Rock

Q: What is note? A: Remade popular music

demo.program:
# The Beatles — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is The Beatles known for?", "Sgt. Pepper"),
    ("What field did The Beatles work in?", "Rock"),
    ("What is lived?", "1960-1970"),
    ("What is field?", "Rock"),
    ("What is known for?", "Sgt. Pepper"),
    ("What is note?", "Remade popular music"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
